app.name: ClerkEye
app.tagline: Check your scholarship documents before you submit
lang.label: Language
limits.title: What ClerkEye cannot see
limits.body: ClerkEye compares the documents you upload. These are possible issues, not a guarantee that your application will be accepted or rejected.
limits.item1: Your bank account must be Aadhaar-seeded (NPCI-mapped) to receive the payment. This cannot be checked from documents.
limits.item2: Your institute has to verify your application on the portal in time. This cannot be checked from documents.
limits.item3: Every office has its own rules for affidavits and declarations. Confirm what your office accepts.
landing.headline: Find the spelling mismatch before the portal does
landing.subhead: Upload your Aadhaar, income certificate, marksheet and bank passbook. ClerkEye compares the names, dates and numbers across them and tells you which differences are likely to get your scholarship application rejected — and which document to fix.
landing.sample.help: Loads three synthetic documents. No camera, no account, no upload to a model.
landing.consent.label: I will use sample or my own documents. I understand that images are processed to read fields and are not stored.
landing.consent.help: ClerkEye keeps everything in this browser tab. Nothing is saved to a server, a database or an account. Do not use a public demo with real Aadhaar or bank documents.
landing.consent.required: Please tick the box to continue.
landing.how.title: How it works
landing.how.step1: Upload 2–4 documents. Cover your Aadhaar number before uploading.
landing.how.step2: Check the fields we read. You must confirm them before anything is compared.
landing.how.step3: Get a colour-coded result, a fix for each problem, and a printable checklist.
landing.privacy.title: Your documents stay in your browser
landing.privacy.body: Fields are read from images and kept in memory only. Nothing is logged, stored or analysed. Only the last 4 digits of a bank account are ever read or shown.
wizard.title: Check documents
upload.title: Upload your documents
upload.help: Add at least two. JPG, PNG or PDF. Take the photo on a flat surface in good light with all four corners visible.
upload.qualityHint: Flat surface, good light, all four corners visible.
upload.minimum: Add at least two documents to continue.
upload.error: We couldn't read this document. Try again with better light, or type the values yourself in the next step.
upload.tooLarge: This file is too large. Please use an image under 1.5 MB or take a new photo.
upload.wrongType: Please use a JPG, PNG or PDF file.
upload.failed: This document could not be read. You can continue without it.
upload.redact.title: Cover the Aadhaar number
upload.redact.help: Drag a black box over the 12-digit number. The covered image is what gets read.
upload.redact.hint: You can draw more than one box. Full Aadhaar numbers are never read or stored.
confirm.title: Check what we read
confirm.help: Correct anything that looks wrong. Nothing is compared until you confirm these values.
confirm.lowConfidenceHelp: Highlighted values were read with low confidence.
results.title: Your results
results.summary: {critical} likely rejection(s), {warning} warning(s), {unverifiable} check(s) we cannot see, {match} matching.
results.empty: No checks could run. Upload at least two documents.
results.mobileHint: Tap a check to see both values and the rule.
detail.title: Check details
detail.notReviewed: This rule has not been checked against the official guideline yet. Treat it as a hint, not a requirement.
fix.title: How to fix these
fix.subtitle: Fix the red items first. Each line tells you what to correct, where to go and what to carry.
fix.reviewedNote: These steps are general guidance. Check what your office accepts.
fix.voiceUnavailable: Voice is not available on this device.
declaration.title: Name variation declaration (template)
declaration.disclaimer: Template only. Many offices require stamp paper or a notarised affidavit. Confirm what your office accepts.

print.title: Pre-submission checklist
print.subtitle: Checks run on {date} with ClerkEye. This is not an official document.
print.noIssues: No mismatches found in the documents you uploaded.
print.footer: ClerkEye checks the documents you upload. It cannot check Aadhaar seeding, institute verification or your office's affidavit requirements. Results are possible issues, not a guarantee.

rule.R-001.label: Bank account holder name must match applicant name
rule.R-002.label: Bank account must be Aadhaar-seeded / NPCI-mapped for payment
rule.R-003.label: Applicant name should be consistent across Aadhaar, marksheet and income certificate
rule.R-004.label: Income certificate must be within its validity period
rule.R-005.label: Father's name should be spelled the same on Aadhaar and the income certificate
rule.R-006.label: Date of birth should match on Aadhaar and the marksheet
rule.R-007.label: Address PIN code should be the same on Aadhaar and the income certificate
rule.R-008.label: Your institute must verify the application on the portal before the deadline
remedy.REM-NAME-BANK.what: The account holder name on your passbook is different from your name on Aadhaar.
remedy.REM-NAME-BANK.where: Your bank branch. Ask for a KYC name update so the name matches your Aadhaar.
remedy.REM-NAME-BANK.carry: Aadhaar, passbook, and a recent photograph. Ask the branch how long the update takes.
remedy.REM-NAME-AADHAAR.what: The name on Aadhaar is different from the name on your other documents.
remedy.REM-NAME-AADHAAR.where: An Aadhaar Enrolment/Update Centre for your Aadhaar, or use the other document as the correct spelling if it is the right one.
remedy.REM-NAME-AADHAAR.carry: Proof of identity and proof of address that both show the correct spelling.
remedy.REM-NAME-MARKSHEET.what: The name on your marksheet is spelled differently from your Aadhaar.
remedy.REM-NAME-MARKSHEET.where: Your school, board or university examination branch, for a corrected marksheet or a name-change certificate.
remedy.REM-NAME-MARKSHEET.carry: Aadhaar, the original marksheet and a written application.
remedy.REM-NAME-INCOME.what: The name on your income certificate is spelled differently from your Aadhaar.
remedy.REM-NAME-INCOME.where: The office that issued the certificate (usually the Tehsil or Revenue office) for a corrected certificate.
remedy.REM-NAME-INCOME.carry: Aadhaar, the old certificate, and proof of income if the office asks for it again.
remedy.REM-DOB.what: The date of birth is different on two documents.
remedy.REM-DOB.where: The office that issued the document with the wrong date. Correct that document so it matches your Aadhaar or your board certificate.
remedy.REM-DOB.carry: Aadhaar, birth certificate or school record, and the document to be corrected.
remedy.REM-CERT-EXPIRED.what: The certificate is older than the scheme allows, or its printed validity has ended.
remedy.REM-CERT-EXPIRED.where: The issuing office, for a fresh certificate.
remedy.REM-CERT-EXPIRED.carry: Aadhaar, proof of income for the current year, and the old certificate.
remedy.REM-CODE.what: A code on one document does not match the other.
remedy.REM-CODE.where: The bank branch (for IFSC) or the issuing office, to correct the printed code.
remedy.REM-CODE.carry: The passbook or certificate that shows the correct code.
remedy.REM-ADDRESS.what: The address or PIN code differs between documents.
remedy.REM-ADDRESS.where: The issuing office, if the scheme needs the address to match.
remedy.REM-ADDRESS.carry: Aadhaar and the certificate you are correcting.
remedy.REM-UNREADABLE.what: We could not read a value on this document, so it could not be checked.
remedy.REM-UNREADABLE.where: Re-take the photo on a flat surface in good light, with all four corners visible, or type the value yourself in the confirm step.
remedy.REM-MISSING.what: This document was not uploaded, so these checks could not run.
remedy.REM-MISSING.where: Upload the document in the upload step, or carry it with you.
explain.type.NAME_ABBREVIATED: One document uses initials instead of the full name. A scholarship office comparing the two strings may read this as a different person, so ask for the full name on both.
explain.type.NAME_SPELLING_VARIANT: The two spellings are close but not identical. A computer comparing the strings will not treat them as the same name.
explain.type.NAME_MISSING_TOKEN: One document leaves out a part of the name. If the portal compares full names, the shorter one will not match.
explain.type.NAME_ORDER: The same name parts appear in a different order. Some portals compare the first word, so the order matters.
explain.type.NAME_DIFFERENT: These look like different names. Check that both documents belong to you and that the spelling is the one on your Aadhaar.
explain.type.DOB_SWAPPED: The day and the month are written in opposite order on the two documents. One of them is probably written the wrong way round.
explain.type.DOB_DIFFERENT: The dates of birth do not agree. One document needs to be corrected before you apply.
explain.type.DOB_PARTIAL: A full date of birth is not visible on one document, so we can only compare the year.
explain.type.ADDRESS_VARIATION: The address or PIN code is worded differently. Many schemes do not require an exact address match, so this is a warning rather than a rejection risk.
explain.type.CERT_EXPIRED: The certificate is outside the validity window, so the office may not accept it.
explain.type.UNREADABLE: A value could not be read from the image, so this check could not run.
explain.type.FIELD_DIFFERENT: Two printed codes disagree. Codes are compared exactly, so one of them is wrong.
explain.portal: This cannot be seen in the documents you upload.
explain.unverifiedRule: This rule has not been checked against the official guideline yet.
explain.summary: {critical} item(s) are likely to hold up your application, {warning} need a look, and {unverifiable} cannot be checked from documents.
rule.R-002.howToCheck: Ask the bank branch or check seeding status through the bank/NPCI process.
rule.R-008.howToCheck: Ask your institute's scholarship cell to confirm they have verified your application, and note the last date on the portal.
explain.type.MATCH_OK: The values agree, so this check passed.
